navigation_observed: Searching 'Game Activity' by pressing right 3x: target never appeared. Screens seen in order: Home -> Home -> People -> Parties & chats
recommendations: PRIORITY 1 - Verify the Xbox Guide menu structure: Manually test the Guide navigation on the console to determine whether pressing Right from a focused game tile in the Guide actually leads to Game Activity or to Dashboard Home. This will distinguish between a console bug (product_defect) and a test scenario error (automation_defect).

PRIORITY 2 - Confirm GIMX session authentication: Check GIMX server logs to verify the session was authenticated before the test. If not, authenticate the session (hold Guide button for 2s) and re-run the test. If the test passes after authentication, the rig fault is confirmed.

PRIORITY 3 - Review test scenario assumptions: Compare the test scenario's expected Guide navigation sequence to Xbox documentation for the console version and region being tested. If the sequence is incorrect, update the test scenario.
